## Checklist

- [ ] Code targets Python 3.9+ and uses the standard library only.
- [ ] Public functions are typed and documented with Google-style docstrings.
- [ ] No inline comments; formatting follows the existing style.
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `pytest tests -q` is green.
- [ ] If a detector was added: it has a positive and a false-positive test, and
      a row in the README rules table.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-facing behaviour changed.
- [ ] No real secrets in any committed test fixture or example.
